description: The multiple/relative COLUMN clause forms (§2023:13.18.14 Format 1) — more than one operand defines a repeating printable item at possibly-unequal horizontal intervals (GR12, the SR10 'multiple COLUMN clause'); PLUS integer-2 positions relative to the line's horizontal counter (GR7/GR8/GR9); COL/COLS/COLUMNS/NUMBERS/ARE are the 2002 spellings (SR1); the LEFT/CENTER/RIGHT alignment phrase (GR6 b)-d), SR9; kb/Work PB1220) gates with them. LIVE (P10 Step 13): compose-time horizontal-counter placement; an absent (PRESENT WHEN) item does not advance the counter (§2023:13.18.41.4 GR3f). The COBOL-85 form was the single absolute 'COLUMN NUMBER IS integer-1' — everything else gates 2002.
display: multiple/relative COLUMN / the COL, COLS, COLUMNS, NUMBERS and ARE spellings / LEFT, CENTER, RIGHT (report group description)
vcr: 2002 RW addition (COLS/COLUMNS reserved 'added 2002'; the 85 format is single-absolute-operand only)

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. VMRMC1.
ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
FILE-CONTROL.
    SELECT RPT ASSIGN TO "vmrmc1.rpt".
DATA DIVISION.
FILE SECTION.
FD RPT REPORT IS R-1.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 W-A PIC 99 VALUE 7.
REPORT SECTION.
RD R-1.
01 D-1 TYPE DE.
   03 LINE PLUS 1.
      05 COLUMN 1 12 PIC 99 SOURCE IS W-A.
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    OPEN OUTPUT RPT.
    INITIATE R-1.
    GENERATE D-1.
    TERMINATE R-1.
    CLOSE RPT.
    STOP RUN.
